item.text:
**It is reasonable to raise the all-male panel as a concern, but it is not, by itself, evidence that the decision was discriminatory.** It may warrant questions about how the consultancy ensures a fair selection process—particularly alongside other evidence of gender bias.

Your qualifications and experience make it understandable that you want an explanation. But the announcement is not a full comparison of the candidates. For a group-head role, client relationships, business development and people management may legitimately carry substantial weight. More years of design experience do not automatically establish that you were the stronger candidate overall.

What would be more telling is:
- Whether the selection criteria were set in advance and applied consistently.
- How your project leadership and qualifications were assessed against those criteria.
- Whether “client relationships” was an advertised requirement or emerged only as a justification afterwards.
- Any gender-related remarks, different treatment in interviews, or a broader pattern of excluding women from leadership.

**I would follow up now, focusing first on the process rather than an allegation.** For example:

> I’m following up on my request of [date] for feedback on the appointment. Could you explain the selection criteria and their relative weighting, and how my experience and leadership record were assessed? I would also appreciate information about the safeguards used to ensure a fair and unbiased process, given the panel’s entirely male composition.

Keep the job advertisement, your application, correspondence and interview notes. Two weeks without a reply does not establish wrongdoing, but you need not wait indefinitely. If you are considering a formal challenge, check local advice promptly: complaint deadlines can be short and may continue running while you await feedback.

Which country was the role in, and was the consultancy private or public-sector? That affects whether panel composition has any specific legal significance and what explanation you may be entitled to.
